title: Atlas Rail
summary: A journey planner that shows the whole route at once, so changing trains stops being a surprise.

body.html:
Atlas connects six cities with four kinds of train. Its old planner listed legs; travellers wanted to see the journey.

The route is the interface

We drew every journey as a single line on a grid of stations, and animated each change of train along it. Delays bend the line instead of hiding in a footnote.
